title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
description: Cylinders land in Surrey and the greatest empire on earth is obsolete by Tuesday. Written as reportage, which is what still makes it frightening.
snippet: No one would have believed in the last years of the nineteenth century that this world was being watched keenly and closely by intelligence…
